transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Thank you so much for fitting me in. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, I've been having a little trouble at work lately. It's probably just me being off my game, I don't want to make a huge deal out of it, but... 

I'm a hairstylist, and lately my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue? Like, even doing the really basic stuff, like sectioning someone's hair or mixing a bowl of color, it just takes me forever right now. And... um, people at the salon have started noticing that I’m just a lot slower than I used to be. Which is really embarrassing, because I always try to do a good job, I promise. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that right. Is that the kind of thing you needed to know?
Beyond feeling slower at work, have you been feeling sad, down, or uninterested in things you usually enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess I have been a little down. I mean, I really shouldn't complain because I know I'm lucky to have my job and everything, but... most days lately, I just wake up with this... this really heavy, flat sadness right in my chest. 

It's hard to explain. It just makes me feel like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning, you know? Like all my goals just feel kind of empty right now. 

I'm sorry, I know that probably sounds really dramatic or ungrateful. I'm usually a very positive person, I swear. Am I... am I answering your question okay?
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this way in the past, or is this the first time you've felt this 'heavy, flat sadness'?

Um... I don't think so? I mean, I've had bad days before, like everyone does, but... nothing that stuck around like this or made it so hard to just do my job. 

Usually, if I feel a little down, I can just kind of push through it and put on a smile for my clients, you know? But this time... it just feels a lot harder to shake off. So, I guess this is the first time it's been quite this... heavy. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm not making it sound worse than it is, I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Aside from your work, how much have these feelings interfered with your ability to handle basic daily tasks like cooking, cleaning, or taking care of yourself?

Um... well, I guess it has affected a few other things, maybe? I mean, I really try to keep it together, but... lately, I've just been so tired. 

Like, at the salon, it's not just that I'm slow. I... I've actually been making some silly mistakes with just the basic routines, which is so not like me. And I've had to cancel on a few things I usually handle with no problem. I think my manager and some of my regular clients are starting to lose trust in me, which is awful because I really value them. 

And outside of work... I guess I've kind of pulled away from my friends a little bit. I just haven't had the energy to be good company. Oh, and I... I stopped going to do the volunteer haircuts at the senior center on Sundays. I feel terrible about that, I really do, because I know they look forward to it. I just... I couldn't get myself out the door. 

I'm sorry, I know that sounds like I'm just giving up on everything. I promise I'm trying my best to keep up. Is it okay that I'm telling you all this? I don't want you to think I'm just lazy or anything.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your sleep patterns lately?

Um... well, my sleep has been okay, I think. But... I guess my eating habits have been a little off lately. 

I mean, I don't want to make a big deal out of it, because I know people get busy and forget to eat sometimes, right? But... I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. Like, I'll get to the end of the day and realize all I've had is coffee and maybe just a few bites of a bagel or something. 

It's not that I'm trying to lose weight on purpose, I promise! I just... I haven't really felt hungry. And I did notice that my clothes have gotten a little looser recently. 

I'm sorry, I should probably be taking better care of myself, especially with my job being so physical. I'll definitely try to do better. Does that answer your question okay? I hope I'm not overcomplicating things.
Beyond the fatigue and the difficulty with work, is there anything at all that you still find yourself looking forward to or truly enjoying right now?

Um... I guess... well, I'm trying to find things to enjoy, I really am. But it's just been... difficult. 

I used to love chatting with my clients, you know? Like, really catching up with them. And I'd always try to help out the newer stylists at the salon if they had questions. On weekends, I'd go hiking with my friends... it was always so much fun. 

But lately... I don't know, I just... I mostly just keep my head down at work. I try to stay out of everyone's way and avoid people as much as I can. It's not that I don't like them anymore! I just... I feel like I don't have that spark in me right now to be the fun, bubbly person they expect. 

I'm sorry, I know that sounds terrible, like I'm being antisocial or something. I really don't want to be that way. I'm hoping it's just a phase and I'll get back to my normal self soon. Is that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about? I hope I'm answering this right.
Have you noticed if other people, like your friends or coworkers, have specifically commented on you moving or speaking much more slowly than usual?

Um... well, I guess... maybe a couple of people have brought it up, just gently. I really don't want you to think I'm doing a bad job or anything! But... yeah. 

It's just, lately, my hands feel like they’re almost... moving through glue at work? Like, even the simple stuff, like sectioning hair or mixing a color, it just takes me forever now. And I guess people have started noticing that I’m just... slower than I used to be. 

My manager asked if I was feeling okay the other day because it was taking me longer to finish my appointments. I felt so embarrassed. I promise I'm really trying to speed back up and be efficient again, I really am. I know time is super important in a salon, and I hate inconveniencing anyone. 

Is that... does that answer what you were asking? I hope I'm giving you the right kind of information.
When you are feeling this way, have you noticed if you ever feel physically restless, like you can't sit still, or do you feel like your body is almost completely 'shut down' and heavy?

Um... well, like I was saying before, it's definitely more of the... the heavy feeling, I guess? Not so much the restless part. 

I really hope I'm not repeating myself too much, but it's just that feeling I mentioned, where my hands just feel so heavy... almost like they're moving through glue when I'm at work. It's just that everything, even the really basic stuff like sectioning someone's hair or mixing up the color bowls, it just... it takes me forever now. 

I'm really not trying to be lazy or anything, I promise! It's just like my body feels so weighed down, and I know people have noticed I'm slower. I'm really trying to push through it so I don't let my clients or my manager down. 

Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right and not just saying the same thing over and over.
Even when something good happens, or when you are around people you usually love, do you find that you are completely unable to feel any sense of pleasure or happiness at all?

Um... well, it's not that I'm completely unable to feel anything good... I really don't want to sound ungrateful when nice things happen or when people try to cheer me up. 

I guess it's just... muted? Like, if my friends try to include me in something, I can kind of smile and appreciate that they care, but I don't feel that big rush of happiness I used to get. It's more like I'm just going through the motions of being happy so I don't bring the mood down. 

I really try to be positive, though! I don't want to be a burden on anyone. I just... I haven't really felt that genuine, deep-down joy in a while, even when I know I should. 

I'm sorry, I hope that doesn't sound too negative. Is that what you meant by your question? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture.

When you have these moments where you're trying to 'go through the motions,' would you say that you are completely unable to feel any sense of pleasure at all, or are you still able to experience at least brief moments of enjoyment?

Um... no, I wouldn't say I'm completely unable to feel anything. I definitely still have little moments where I genuinely enjoy things. 

Like, if a client really loves her blowout, or if one of the other girls tells a really funny joke in the breakroom... I do feel a little spark of actual happiness, you know? It's just brief. It doesn't stick around as long as it used to. But I really try to hold onto those good moments when they happen! I promise I'm not just, like, miserable all the time. I really do try to appreciate the good things. 

Is that... does that help clarify what I meant before? I just really don't want to make it sound worse than it actually is, and I want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your ability to concentrate or make decisions lately, such as when you are at work or managing your personal tasks?

Um... well, maybe just a little bit? But I'm really trying hard not to let it affect my work, I promise! 

It's just... sometimes, I'll be looking at the color formulas, or even just glancing at the appointment screen, and my brain just kind of... blanks out for a second. It's so silly, I end up second-guessing these really simple things that I used to do completely automatically. Like, I know how to mix a level 6 ash, but suddenly I'm just staring at it, trying to make sure I'm doing it right. 

I always double-check everything, though, so I haven't messed up any clients' hair! I really pride myself on doing a good job. It just takes me a little longer to decide on things right now. 

I hope that doesn't make me sound incompetent or anything. I really am trying my best to stay focused. Does that make sense, what I'm trying to say?
